{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Democratic Socialist Labor Commission will facilitate and coordinate with local DSA chapters to educate DSA members and support boycott activity.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA believes Marriott hotel workers are 100 percent correct when they say ONE JOB SHOULD BE ENOUGH to provide for themselves and their families.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The fight of Marriott hotel workers has inspired the working class.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The fight of Marriott hotel workers is a courageous escalation in the movement of workers standing up for fair wages and their communities all across the country in 2018.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Striking teachers, healthcare workers, and university workers are part of the movement of workers standing up for fair wages and their communities all across the country in 2018.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
